Finding and referenced Research Context limitations and explicit challenge routes preserve declaration structure without proving practical challengeability or owner authority.
Source/provenance,wording/support,Question/Scope,temporal and route handles do not authenticate actual investigation,source currentness,origin,adequacy,truth or acceptance.
